question: If the bot scanned all Polymarket markets, would profitable complement arb show up much more often?
answer: No. At rest, YES+NO taker complement is empty across the liquid universe. More names on a 2s HTTP poll does not create edge. The only theoretically takeable 1-tick race is fee-free geopolitics, and that race is a websocket/MM game, not a wider poll.

universe.note: Gamma offset caps at 2100. Volume-sorted top 2100 still has ~$1k/day at the tail, so this is the economically relevant set.

complete_set_neg_risk.trap: Summing YES asks across a few legs of a big event looks like 50-90c 'arb'. Those samples are incomplete (3 of 30 candidates, 7 of 30 MLB teams) or not a partition (nested 'by date?', independent country YES/NO).

example_full_sets_taker_net_after_fees.title: When will the next Google Gemini Pro model be released?
How many seats will United Russia win in the next Russian legislative election?

fee_vs_tick_at_the_money.formula: pair taker fee at 50/50 ≈ feeRate / 2 per share. Need ask_sum < 1 - feeRate/2.

rows.note: Any ask_sum < 1 is +EV. Rest-state still quotes 1.001.

why_more_markets_does_not_help_this_bot: Every liquid binary is already quoted to 1 tick of overround. Scanning 12 vs 2000 names does not change ask_sum from 1.01 to 0.97.
2s HTTP of 2000 binaries is ~4000 CLOB reads/loop. The current loop already spends seconds on 10 books. A full HTTP poll cannot win a 80-200ms requote race.
Wide sports books (asks 1.00+1.00, bids empty) look like huge maker gross and are how paper bled: one-sided, no size, adverse selection.
Independent multi-YES (countries / price ladders / nested dates) are directional baskets, not a $1 complete set.
what_would_actually_increase_plus_ev_rat: Websocket on a curated liquid set (not more HTTP names). Edge is being inside the MM requote window when one leg is lifted.
Only fee-free geopolitics can take a 1-tick underround. Politics/sports/crypto need several ticks at the money.
True neg-risk bundles require the FULL outcome list (n listed == n live) plus per-leg fees. Rest-state those also sit at par.
Maker 1-tick remains the only rest-state complement, and only in a short window with balanced legs and rescue. Expanding that to long-dated geopolitics increases toxic time.
recommendation_for_surf_arb: Do not HTTP-scan the top-volume universe. Point the engine at 15M+1H crypto windows, all liquid assets, soonest expiry first. See research/target_markets.json.
